checks.what: every gait-event file in the ZIP read
stride times between 0.4 and 3 s for 98% of strides
every participant has strides of both feet in every session

differences: The gait-events item covers 39 of the 49 participants (80 events files; 7 participants have one environment only and some sessions are split in parts) and the cortisol spreadsheet, the only per-participant demographics, lists 47 (one participant with events, LSIE_14, is not in it, so that participant has no age or sex). The paper's 49 participants (20 men, 29 women, mean age 22.7) therefore cannot be counted from the deposit: the spreadsheet gives 19 men, 28 women and mean age 22.8 for 47, so those numbers are not used as checks; its age range 18-45 is reproduced.
Strides whose two heel strikes are not both inside a labelled condition (before the baseline marker, between conditions, or in a file missing a condition marker) are left out.
The paper's and the deposit's other outcomes (EEG, cortisol, visual search performance) are not part of the converted file.
